finding.statement: Forge-to-Distillery replay lookup and write/counter mutation were not serialized under explicit SQLite write intent. The current supervisor research receipt already demonstrated that two same-replay writers can race into a UNIQUE IntegrityError rather than deterministic DUPLICATE/REPLAY_IDENTITY_CONFLICT classification.
finding.external_crosscheck: SQLite documents that BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately and prevents another connection from acquiring concurrent write intent; in WAL mode IMMEDIATE serializes writers while readers may continue.

hypothesis: Commit schema setup and acquire BEGIN IMMEDIATE before the first replay lookup so lookup, measured-evidence conflict classification, packet insert and token counters execute as one serialized admission transaction.
counterhypothesis: The unique replay index alone is sufficient to preserve deterministic admission semantics under concurrency.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_GENERIC_SQLITE_SEMANTICS_SCOPE_BY_EXISTING_GO873_RECEIPT: uniqueness protects durable row cardinality but can expose an IntegrityError race instead of the declared replay classification contract.

delta.source_change: commit schema DDL, then BEGIN IMMEDIATE before reading any Forge evaluation row or performing replay lookup
test_invariants: write intent is active before first admit_one/replay lookup
a contender BEGIN IMMEDIATE is locked while admission transaction is active
two concurrent same-replay writers finish without exception
exactly one writer admits and one classifies DUPLICATE

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED_SOURCE_SCOPE: makes replay admission classification deterministic under concurrent ingestion
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED: promotes atomic lookup-classify-write-counter semantics as a reusable Typed Entry/HCU causal-admission invariant
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED_DATASET_SAFETY_SCOPE: prevents parallel J-Space/GWT trace ingestion from degrading into ambiguous process failure or accounting races

next_exact_gate: Execute the concurrent replay regression and existing replay suite on an admitted exact-source zero-cost surface, then run the repository-bound live Forge-to-Distillery witness requiring one evidence-qualified ACCEPT -> one persistent packet -> accepted_dataset_tokens > 0 -> timestamp/narration/delta_id semantic replay +0.
